postProcessing: base capture (blank-canvas) captured, then pixel (5,2) forced to (200,200,200) and pixel (6,2) forced to (201,201,201). Under integer BT.601 luminance with R=G=B=v the result is exactly v (299+587+114==1000), so these land on INK_MAX_LEVEL's exact boundary: 200 is ink, 201 is background.
